title: 从马克笔到幼儿园家具
desc: 聊聊外贸人转型赛道的真实感受——为什么从教玩具切入比文具更有想象空间。

lines.speaker: james
lines.en: So Quinn used to sell markers and highlighters, right?
lines.cn: 所以 Quinn 以前卖马克笔和荧光笔？

lines.speaker: emma
lines.en: Yeah, stationery for several years. Then she joined Wenshang, a kindergarten furniture maker in Jiaoxia, Wenzhou.
lines.cn: 对，做了几年文具。后来加入温州桥下镇的温尚，一家幼儿园家具厂。

lines.speaker: james
lines.en: That is a big switch. Why teaching toys?
lines.cn: 这跨度挺大。为什么选教玩具？

lines.speaker: emma
lines.en: Whole-kindergarten projects. A stationery order might be 500 dollars, but a full kindergarten project is 200,000 dollars.
lines.cn: 整园项目。文具订单可能 500 美金，但一个整园项目是 20 万美金。

lines.speaker: james
lines.en: Ten to forty times bigger. That is the real deal.
lines.cn: 10 到 40 倍。这才是真正的生意。

lines.speaker: emma
lines.en: Plus, future pet category. The same woodworking skills apply to cat trees and dog houses.
lines.cn: 加上未来的宠物赛道。同样的木工技能可以做猫爬架和狗屋。

lines.speaker: james
lines.en: So the skill set transfers: wood, safety standards, custom design, big project negotiation.
lines.cn: 所以技能是迁移的：木材、安全标准、定制设计、大项目谈判。

lines.speaker: emma
lines.en: Exactly. EN71 for toys, EN1176 for outdoor, FSC for wood. Once you learn these, you can sell anything.
lines.cn: 对。EN71 玩具、EN1176 户外、FSC 木材。学会这些，什么都能卖。

lines.speaker: james
lines.en: The more technical the product, the higher the margin and the stickier the client.
lines.cn: 产品越技术化，利润越高，客户越粘。

lines.speaker: emma
lines.en: That is why Play Speak exists. To help people like Quinn talk the talk.
lines.cn: 所以 Play Speak 存在。帮像 Quinn 这样的人会说这套话。
